_meta.description: D1 seed data for the pm_projects/pm_epics/pm_stories/pm_tasks hierarchy tables. workspaceId maps to the repo route: /repos/jmbish04/core-github-api/projects

pm_projects.title: AI Learning & Pattern Recognition Engine
pm_projects.description: A continuous improvement service that extracts all AI coding conversations (Jules, Gemini, Stitch), enriches them with Cloudflare Docs context, identifies recurring failure patterns, and automatically submits PRs to core-github-standardization to immunize future agents against known mistakes.

pm_epics.title: Database Schema — Learning Micro-Domain
pm_epics.description: Create all 10 Drizzle ORM schema files for the learning domain under backend/src/db/schemas/github/learning/. Reuse existing app/tags.ts — no duplicate tags table.

pm_epics.title: Learning Ingestion Service
pm_epics.description: Port log_conversations.py logic into a TypeScript LearningIngestionService. Sources: Jules SDK (JulesService), GitHub Octokit (getOctokit), Stitch MCP. Deduplication via sourceIdentifier unique index.

pm_epics.title: LearningAgent Durable Object
pm_epics.description: Stateful Durable Object agent with Contemplation Gate (anti-light-switch). Tools: enrichMessage (CF Docs), tagMessage, analyzeMessage (Workers AI), createInsight, contemplateFix (Vectorize + D1 reflection), submitImprovementPr, issueRemediationComment.

pm_epics.title: Cloudflare Workflow + Daily Cron
pm_epics.description: LearningWorkflow using Cloudflare Workflows product for durable step execution. Daily cron at 0 6 * * * UTC. Manual trigger via POST /api/learning/sync.

pm_epics.title: API Routes
pm_epics.description: Hono OpenAPI routes at /api/learning/ for sync trigger, session listing, insight search/filter, global standardization score, and upscale endpoint for Jules orchestration.

pm_epics.title: Active PR Interceptor (Real-time Remediation)
pm_epics.description: Webhook-driven interceptor that fires on PR opened/synchronize events. Scans PR diff against known ai_insights patterns and posts remediation comments via user-persona token. Includes D1-backed merge queue for post-merge template hardening.

pm_epics.title: Frontend Control Plane (Astro + Dark Shadcn)
pm_epics.description: 4 Astro pages under frontend/src/pages/learning/: dashboard (Recharts trendlines), sessions (Shadcn Table audit log), board (kibo-ui Kanban: DETECTED→IN_VERIFICATION→IMMUNIZED), showcase (Standardization library + Upscale button).

pm_epics.title: Health Monitoring
pm_epics.description: Add /health/learning endpoint to existing health suite. Monitor AI Gateway latency, Sandbox SDK container availability, last successful learning run timestamp, open insight PR count.

pm_stories.title: Create 10 Drizzle schema files
pm_stories.description: One file per table: sessions.ts, threads.ts, messages.ts, enrichment.ts, tagMapping.ts, aiInsights.ts, aiInsightMessages.ts, aiInsightPrs.ts, aiInsightPrMapping.ts, aiPrReflections.ts. Each exported with Zod OpenAPI schemas.

pm_stories.title: Wire schema barrel and run migration
pm_stories.description: Create learning/index.ts barrel. Add 'export * from ./learning' to backend/src/db/schemas/github/index.ts. Run npm run migrate:db and verify 10 new learning_* tables in D1.

pm_stories.title: Jules ingestion
pm_stories.description: Use existing JulesService from backend/src/services/julius/jules.ts. List all sessions + activities. Map session → learning_threads (source: jules), activities → learning_messages. Dedup by sourceIdentifier unique index.

pm_stories.title: GitHub PR ingestion
pm_stories.description: Use getOctokit() from backend/src/services/octokit/core.ts. Search merged PRs by jmbish04. Fetch PR body + issue comments + review comments. Map PR → thread, comments → messages. Dedup by PR URL.

pm_stories.title: Stitch ingestion
pm_stories.description: Call Stitch MCP paginated API (mirrors _sync_stitch from log_conversations.py). Map project/screen → thread, prompts → messages. Dedup by stitch/{projectId}/{screenName}.

pm_stories.title: Core agent tools: enrich, tag, analyze
pm_stories.description: Implement enrichMessage (CF Docs MCP → learning_enrichment), tagMessage (query app.tags → learning_tag_mapping, createTag if new), analyzeMessage (Workers AI → messages.aiAnalysis). All inference via AI Gateway.

pm_stories.title: Pattern detection and insight creation
pm_stories.description: Group threads by category. If 3+ threads share the same correction pattern → createInsight (learning_ai_insights, status: PENDING). Link messages via learning_ai_insight_messages for audit traceability.

pm_stories.title: Contemplation Gate (anti-light-switch)
pm_stories.description: Before submitting any PR: query VECTORIZE_INDEX for semantic similarity to prior patterns. Query ai_pr_reflections for prior outcomes. If category was already addressed and deemed successful → skip. If FAILED → escalate to UPGRADE_TEMPLATE target (core-github-standardization).

pm_stories.title: Signal-driven vectorization
pm_stories.description: Only vectorize messages with ai_analysis populated OR linked to an ai_insight. Vectorize into VECTORIZE_INDEX binding. Do NOT vectorize every raw prompt — prevents noise in semantic search.

pm_stories.title: LearningWorkflow class
pm_stories.description: Create backend/src/workflows/learning.ts following pattern from backend/src/workflows/health.ts. Steps: createSession, ingestConversations, runAnalysis, finalizeSession. Each step has timeout + retry.

pm_stories.title: Register workflow and cron in wrangler.jsonc
pm_stories.description: Add to workflows array: { name: learning-workflow, class_name: LearningWorkflow, binding: LEARNING_WORKFLOW }. Add to triggers.crons: '0 6 * * *'.

pm_stories.title: Core learning routes
pm_stories.description: POST /api/learning/sync (manual trigger → dispatch LearningWorkflow), GET /api/learning/sessions, GET /api/learning/insights (filter by category/status/q), GET /api/learning/insights/:id.

pm_stories.title: Upscale and global insights routes
pm_stories.description: GET /api/learning/insights/global (aggregated Standardization Score per category). POST /api/learning/upscale (fetch standardization files + start Jules session for active repo audit).

pm_stories.title: PR webhook interceptor
pm_stories.description: Wire learning-interceptor.ts into existing PR webhook handlers (backend/src/automations/pr/). On PR opened/synchronize: scan diff vs known ai_insights patterns. If match → post comment via user-persona GH token targeting assigned agent.

pm_stories.title: Post-merge template hardening queue
pm_stories.description: After PR merge webhook: check if merged PR was flagged in learning_ai_insight_prs. If yes → trigger Jules session to apply fix to core-github-standardization. Use D1 mergeQueueStatus field to prevent duplicate triggers.

pm_stories.title: /learning/dashboard — Trendlines
pm_stories.description: Recharts line chart: 'Manual Corrections per PR' vs 'Immunized Rules' over time. Queries learning_sessions aggregated data. Dark Shadcn theme.

pm_stories.title: /learning/sessions — Audit Log
pm_stories.description: Shadcn Table of analysis runs. Expandable Collapsible rows → threads → enrichment → CF Docs grounding responses → ai_analysis per message.

pm_stories.title: /learning/board — Insight Kanban
pm_stories.description: kibo-ui Kanban board mapping learning_ai_insights.status: DETECTED (PENDING) → IN_VERIFICATION → IMMUNIZED. Drag-and-drop updates status via PATCH /api/learning/insights/:id.

pm_stories.title: /learning/showcase — Standards Library + Upscale
pm_stories.description: Grid of Shadcn Cards for every standard in core-github-standardization (tsconfig.json, AGENTS.md, /health/index.ts, etc). Each card: 'View Content' dialog (fetches raw file from GitHub) + 'Upscale Current Repo' primary button → POST /api/learning/upscale.

pm_stories.title: /health/learning endpoint
pm_stories.description: Create backend/src/health/learning.ts. Checks: AI Gateway latency for CF Docs enrichment, Sandbox SDK container availability, last successful learning_sessions run timestamp, count of open learning_ai_insight_prs. Register in existing health suite.

pm_tasks.title: Create sessions.ts — learning_sessions table
pm_tasks.description: Fields: id (int PK autoincrement), timestamp (text ISO default), actionTaken (boolean default false), actionRationale (text nullable). Include createSelectSchema + createInsertSchema with .openapi().

pm_tasks.title: Create threads.ts — learning_threads table
pm_tasks.description: Fields: id, sessionId FK, timestamp, source enum(jules/stitch/github_pr/github_comment/other), sourceIdentifier (unique), githubRepo. Add unique index on sourceIdentifier for deduplication.

pm_tasks.title: Create messages.ts — learning_messages table
pm_tasks.description: Fields: id, sessionId FK, threadId FK, timestamp, author, message, aiAnalysis (nullable, updated post-processing). Add indexes on threadId and sessionId.

pm_tasks.title: Create enrichment.ts — learning_enrichment table
pm_tasks.description: Fields: id, messageId FK, timestamp (default now), queryForMcp, mcpResponse (nullable), aiAnalysis (nullable). 1:many per message for multiple CF Docs queries.

pm_tasks.title: Create tagMapping.ts — learning_tag_mapping table
pm_tasks.description: IMPORTANT: references existing app/tags.ts (tags.id as text FK). Fields: id, tagId (→ tags.id), messageId FK, rationale. Do NOT create a new learning_tags table.

pm_tasks.title: Create aiInsights.ts — learning_ai_insights table
pm_tasks.description: Fields: id, sessionId FK, threadId FK, timestamp, category, insightAnalysis, suggestedImprovement, observedAttemptsReview, status enum(PENDING/IN_VERIFICATION/IMMUNIZED/REVERTED/OBSERVED). Index on category.

pm_tasks.title: Create aiInsightMessages.ts — learning_ai_insight_messages table
pm_tasks.description: Links messages to insights for audit traceability. Fields: id, aiInsightId FK, messageId FK, sessionId FK.

pm_tasks.title: Create aiInsightPrs.ts — learning_ai_insight_prs table
pm_tasks.description: Tracks PRs submitted to fix flagged issues. Fields: id, sessionId FK, timestamp, repoOwner, repoName, prNumber, prUrl, prDescription, outcome enum(OPEN/MERGED/CLOSED/REVERTED).

pm_tasks.title: Create aiInsightPrMapping.ts — learning_ai_insight_pr_mapping table
pm_tasks.description: Links insights to their fix PRs. Fields: id, insightId FK, insightPrId FK, aiRationale, aiSuccessCriteria.

pm_tasks.title: Create aiPrReflections.ts — learning_ai_pr_reflections table
pm_tasks.description: Anti-light-switch guard. Fields: id, sessionId FK, newInsightId FK, priorInsightId FK (nullable), insightPrId FK (nullable), agentAnalysis, prSuccessDetermination.

pm_tasks.title: Create learning/index.ts barrel
pm_tasks.description: Export all 10 schema files from backend/src/db/schemas/github/learning/index.ts

pm_tasks.title: Update backend/src/db/schemas/github/index.ts
pm_tasks.description: Add: export * from './learning'

pm_tasks.title: Run D1 migration
pm_tasks.description: npm run migrate:db — verify 10 new learning_* tables created in D1 console

pm_tasks.title: Create services/learning/types.ts
pm_tasks.description: Define ConversationThread, ConversationMessage, IngestionResult interfaces

pm_tasks.title: Implement Jules ingestion in ingestion.ts
pm_tasks.description: Use JulesService.listSessions() from backend/src/services/julius/jules.ts. Map session.name → sourceIdentifier, activities → messages. Skip if sourceIdentifier exists (unique constraint).

pm_tasks.title: Implement GitHub PR ingestion
pm_tasks.description: Use getOctokit(env) from backend/src/services/octokit/core.ts. Query: is:pr is:merged author:jmbish04. Fetch PR body + /issues/{n}/comments + /pulls/{n}/comments (review comments). Map to threads + messages.

pm_tasks.title: Implement Stitch ingestion
pm_tasks.description: Call Stitch MCP paginated API following pattern from log_conversations.py _sync_stitch method. POST /tools/stitch/scan_conversations_paginated. Map project/screen → thread, prompts → messages.

pm_tasks.title: Implement enrichMessage tool
pm_tasks.description: Generate CF Docs query from message content. Call cloudflare-docs MCP search tool. Insert row into learning_enrichment. Routing through AI Gateway.

pm_tasks.title: Implement tagMessage tool
pm_tasks.description: Query existing app.tags table. Select matching tags based on message content. Insert into learning_tag_mapping. If genuinely new category (confirmed by Workers AI) → insert new row into app.tags first.

pm_tasks.title: Implement analyzeMessage tool
pm_tasks.description: Workers AI (via AI Gateway): synthesize message + enrichment results + applied tags → update learning_messages.aiAnalysis. Model: @cf/meta/llama-3.1-8b-instruct or claude via AI Gateway.

pm_tasks.title: Implement pattern detection (3-thread threshold)
pm_tasks.description: After processing all messages: group by correction category. If same category appears in 3+ distinct threads → call createInsight. Insert learning_ai_insights row (status: PENDING).

pm_tasks.title: Link messages to insights via aiInsightMessages
pm_tasks.description: For each new ai_insight: insert rows into learning_ai_insight_messages linking the contributing messages. Required for audit traceability.

pm_tasks.title: Implement contemplateFix tool — Vectorize semantic search
pm_tasks.description: Generate embedding for current pattern using @cf/baai/bge-small-en-v1.5. Query VECTORIZE_INDEX (topK: 3). If matches found → mark as repeatOffender.

pm_tasks.title: Implement contemplateFix — D1 prior outcomes check
pm_tasks.description: Query learning_ai_pr_reflections for prior entries in same category within last 90 days. If prSuccessDetermination = FAILED → action: UPGRADE_TEMPLATE (target core-github-standardization). Otherwise: SUGGEST_PATCH.

pm_tasks.title: Vectorize filtered messages
pm_tasks.description: After analyzeMessage: if message has ai_analysis OR is linked to an ai_insight → generate embedding + insert into VECTORIZE_INDEX. Do not vectorize messages with no analysis.

pm_tasks.title: Create LearningWorkflow class
pm_tasks.description: backend/src/workflows/learning.ts. 4 steps: createSession (insert learning_sessions), ingestConversations (LearningIngestionService), runAnalysis (dispatch LearningAgent DO), finalizeSession (update session actionTaken). Follow health.ts pattern.

pm_tasks.title: Register LearningWorkflow in wrangler.jsonc
pm_tasks.description: Add: { name: 'learning-workflow', class_name: 'LearningWorkflow', binding: 'LEARNING_WORKFLOW' } to workflows array.

pm_tasks.title: Add daily cron trigger
pm_tasks.description: Add '0 6 * * *' to triggers.crons in wrangler.jsonc. Wire cron handler to dispatch LearningWorkflow.

pm_tasks.title: Implement POST /api/learning/sync
pm_tasks.description: Dispatch LEARNING_WORKFLOW. Return { workflowRunId, status: 'triggered' }.

pm_tasks.title: Implement GET /api/learning/sessions
pm_tasks.description: List learning_sessions ordered by timestamp desc, limit 50. Use Zod OpenAPI schema.

pm_tasks.title: Implement GET /api/learning/insights
pm_tasks.description: Filter by category, status, q (like search on insightAnalysis). Ordered by timestamp desc. Use Zod OpenAPI schema.

pm_tasks.title: Implement GET /api/learning/insights/global
pm_tasks.description: Aggregate learning_ai_insights grouped by category. Count IMMUNIZED vs PENDING. Return 'Standardization Score' per category.

pm_tasks.title: Implement POST /api/learning/upscale
pm_tasks.description: Fetch standardization file contents from core-github-standardization via GitHub API. Start Jules session with context: 'Audit {repoName} against these standards'. Return { julesSessionId }.

pm_tasks.title: Wire PR webhook handler
pm_tasks.description: Add learning-interceptor.ts call in backend/src/automations/pr/ for opened/synchronize events. Extract AI agent author from PR. Scan diff keywords against top learning_ai_insights categories.

pm_tasks.title: Implement remediation comment posting
pm_tasks.description: Use user-persona GH token (GH_TOKEN). Post comment: '🔍 Pattern analysis detected: {category}. @{agent} please address: {prompt}'. Must use user persona — not app token.

pm_tasks.title: Implement merge queue logic
pm_tasks.description: On PR merged webhook: check learning_ai_insight_prs for matching prUrl. If found and mergeQueueStatus = PENDING_TEMPLATE → trigger Jules session for core-github-standardization update. Update mergeQueueStatus = PROCESSING.

pm_tasks.title: Build /learning/dashboard Astro page
pm_tasks.description: Recharts LineChart showing manual corrections per PR over time vs immunized rules count. Data from GET /api/learning/insights/global. Dark Shadcn theme.

pm_tasks.title: Build /learning/sessions Astro page
pm_tasks.description: Shadcn Table with collapsible rows. Columns: date, actionTaken, threadCount, insightCount, prsSubmitted. Expanded: thread list → messages → enrichment docs context.

pm_tasks.title: Build /learning/board Kanban page
pm_tasks.description: kibo-ui Kanban board. Columns map to learning_ai_insights.status: PENDING (Detected), IN_VERIFICATION, IMMUNIZED. Cards show category, insightAnalysis, linked PR. Drag → PATCH /api/learning/insights/:id.

pm_tasks.title: Build /learning/showcase standards grid
pm_tasks.description: Shadcn Card grid. Fetch standardization file list from GET /repos/jmbish04/core-github-standardization/contents. Each card: filename, last updated, 'View Content' dialog. 'Upscale Current Repo' primary button.

pm_tasks.title: Implement Upscale button action
pm_tasks.description: Button click → POST /api/learning/upscale with { repoName: activeRepo }. Show loading state → poll Jules session → display implementation plan in Dialog/Sheet.

pm_tasks.title: Create backend/src/health/learning.ts
pm_tasks.description: HealthStepResult checks: (1) AI Gateway latency < 2s for CF Docs query, (2) last learning_sessions.timestamp within 25 hours, (3) open learning_ai_insight_prs count < 10. Return health/failure with details.

pm_tasks.title: Register learning health check in health suite
pm_tasks.description: Add checkLearningHealth import to the main health orchestrator. Wire into existing /health route response.
